# Agent guide
## Project structure
- This is a dependency-free, single-page browser app. `index.html` loads `styles.css` and `script.js` directly; there is no build step or package manager. - `script.js` contains timer, preset, fullscreen, and alert-audio behavior in a single IIFE. Its DOM lookups rely on the IDs/classes in `index.html`. - Preset values are declared in `index.html` as `data-total-seconds` and `data-warning-seconds` attributes and handled by the `#preset-buttons` delegated click listener. - `styles.css` defines theme colors as `:root` custom properties. Timer warning/expired states are updated by `updateVisualState()` in JavaScript. - `ring.mp3` is the primary alert sound; `script.js` falls back to Web Audio beeps if playback fails.
## Run and validate
- Open `index.html` directly in Edge or Chrome. For the documented PowerShell launch commands, see `README.md`. - There is no automated build or test command. Check behavior in the browser, including presets, warning/zero states, audio, and fullscreen.
## Change conventions
- Keep the app's static-file structure and avoid adding dependencies or a build system for changes that fit the existing implementation. - When changing controls or presets, keep the HTML IDs/data attributes in sync with the selectors and event handling in `script.js`. - Keep configurable theme colors in the `:root` variables in `styles.css`; timer-state colors are currently set by `updateVisualState()` in `script.js`.

# Countdown Timer (Single Page)
This project is a single-page timer built with only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
## Requirements covered
- Runs directly in Edge and Chrome on Windows (no extra software needed). - One webpage UI split vertically: - Top 5/6: large countdown timer (`MM:SS`) - Bottom 1/6: control panel - Control panel includes separate numeric inputs for minutes and seconds and a warning-threshold seconds input. - Control panel includes preset quick-start buttons that set timer/warning values, reset, start, and request fullscreen. - Control panel includes a `ding!` button that plays the alert sound (`ring.mp3`, or the 3-beep fallback) on demand. - Works in normal browser mode and fullscreen mode.
## Configuration - Configurable colors in CSS only (`styles.css` variables): - top panel background (`--top-bg`) - bottom panel background (`--bottom-bg`) - text (`--text-color`) - Initial colors: - top panel: bright green (`#39ff14`) - bottom panel: black (`#000000`) - text: white (`#ffffff`) - When remaining time is greater than 0 but lower than the warning threshold: - top panel background turns bright red - a triangular warning icon with `!` appears to the right of the timer - When the timer reaches zero: - top panel background turns black - `ring.mp3` plays - if `ring.mp3` cannot play, a fallback of 3 short beeps plays - warning icon remains visible and blinks - countdown continues into negative time (for example, `-00:01`, `-00:02`)
## Files
- `index.html` - page structure - `styles.css` - layout and styles - `script.js` - timer logic, fullscreen, and alert playback - `ring.mp3` - alert sound played at zero
## Run
Open `index.html` in Edge or Chrome.
Examples from PowerShell:
```powershell Start-Process msedge.exe "C:\UTV\timer\index.html" Start-Process chrome.exe "C:\UTV\timer\index.html" ```
